title: Shinonome Akito — Strategy Meeting With Cheesecake〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Main Street

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Kohane, are you free tomorrow?
You too, Akito, Toya!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, I don't have any animal caretaker committee duties to do tomorrow, so I was planning on going home early to practice somewhere...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I have library committee business to take care of tomorrow... But I may be able to leave early if I tell them what's going on.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'm free too. I don't have work tomorrow, so my plan was to go train somewhere.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Then, let's all go to Crawl Green!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What? To Crawl Green...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Crawl Green... I haven't been there since...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Not too long ago, just going there would've been enough to make me so nervous that I'd've frozen up or lost control of my voice...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (But now...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Apologies for the wait, Akito.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Hey.
You all done with committee stuff?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, that's all settled. And I'd already told the seniors that I had a prior engagement.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Also, you said that you wanted to do something before we headed to Crawl Green...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Waiting around twiddling our thumbs seems like a waste of time, right?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So, wanna sing for a bit?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Just the two of us...?
It's been quite a while.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hm? Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
No, it's just...
You seem at ease with yourself...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That's because I am. I feel fine.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I have you guys, Ken and Taiga to thank for that.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Anyway, let's sing.
Starting with our usual when we were still the BAD DOGS.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Okay, let's begin.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (He's singing with quite a bit of power. I have to think he's more than just fine...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (So, why don't I also...?)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (It's been a while since we sang this together, but he's rock solid... No, wait...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (He sounds like he's having a lot of fun!)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Did he just improvise that part? Well played...)

rows.Speaker: Passerby A
rows.Line: Hey, aren't they from Vivid BAD SQUAD?!

rows.Speaker: Passerby B
rows.Line:
Yeah, it's the BAD DOGS!
These days, it's pretty rare to see just the two of them singing!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huff... Huff...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I was thinking that we'd do a light session, but we both ended up going all out.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I blame you for sprinting from the start. I had no choice but to try to keep up...

rows.Speaker: Passerby A
rows.Line:
Way to go, BAD DOGS!
That was awesome!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, thanks!

rows.Speaker: Passersby
rows.Line: It's been forever since you guys last sang on the street! Don't stop now!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sorry, but we gotta be somewhere after this. But if you wanna hear us sing that much...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Come to our third event!
At Crawl Green!

rows.Speaker: Passerby B
rows.Line: C-Crawl Green?!

rows.Speaker: Passersby
rows.Line:
What?! There?!
No way! I can't wait!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We're meeting with the owner today, so we promise to let you guys know once we have more details.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito, we should go...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Right.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I feel a little better now...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hm? About what?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: About going to Crawl Green. You said that you wanted to do something before we went there, so it seemed like you had something on your mind...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Of course I had something on my mind.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
This is my chance to redeem myself.
I need to do everything I can do to make that happen.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Right.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But we need to make sure our meeting goes well first. So, Toya, let's go.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, let's.
